question: Plot the Fibonacci sequence.

cells.step: Build the first 20 Fibonacci numbers, so the figure can draw them.
cells.code:
fib = [0, 1]
while len(fib) < 20:
    fib.append(fib[-1] + fib[-2])
seq = pd.Series(fib, name='fibonacci')
print(seq.tail().to_string())

cells.step: Figures: the first 20 Fibonacci numbers, by position
cells.code:
import plotly.graph_objects as go
fig = go.Figure(go.Scatter(x=seq.index, y=seq.values, mode='lines+markers'))
fig.update_layout(title='The first 20 Fibonacci numbers', xaxis_title='n', yaxis_title='F(n)')
fig.show()
